<domain>
## Phase Boundary

The system produces GitHub activity scores measuring genuine ML code activity versus absence or abandonment for target companies. For any company with a mapped GitHub organization, the system analyzes repo count, language breakdown, commit recency, and ML framework imports (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn in requirements/pyproject). The GitHub activity score (0-100) distinguishes between active ML development, dormant repos, and no GitHub presence. GitHub data respects API rate limits (5,000 req/hr with token).
